tool_config.name: zapisat_pokaz_nightdesk_demo
tool_config.description: Books the showing time the caller chose. The caller picking an option is NOT permission: first ask 'Shall I book it?' with that exact time, wait for yes, and only then call this — once per call. Pass start exactly as it came from svobodnye_okna_nightdesk_demo. Say it is booked ONLY if the result has ok true; if ok is false, say the meaning of soobshchenie and offer another time or the self-guided tour.

obyavlenie_id.description: The apartment code of the showing.

start.description: The start value of the chosen time, copied character for character from svobodnye_okna_nightdesk_demo.

imya.description: First and last name exactly as the caller spelled it and confirmed, in Latin letters.

telefon.description: The confirmed phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +19175550161.

email.description: Only if the caller gave an email and confirmed the spelling; otherwise leave it out.

yazyk.description: Language of the conversation right now.
